info.name: PMS cashbook search — local contract
info.description: Calls the actual CashbookView against a synthetic DB session and serializer. Does not verify PostgreSQL, authentication, real data or concurrency. Local only; run with --no-report-events.

exec: if (pm.variables.get('baseUrl') !== 'http://127.0.0.1:5224') throw new Error('This synthetic contract collection only runs against its loopback harness');

item.name: Unfiltered baseline: 1000 period entries, 20 per page

exec: pm.test('HTTP 200 from the actual-view local harness', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Explicit synthetic evidence boundary', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Fixture-Mode')).to.eql('actual-view-synthetic-session-no-db-auth'));
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Unfiltered matching total and page size', () => { pm.expect(body.pagination.totalItems).to.eql(1000); pm.expect(body.ledger).to.have.lengthOf(20); });
pm.test('Needle record is absent from unfiltered first page', () => pm.expect(body.ledger.map(row => row.id)).not.to.include('entry-0001'));

pm.test('Exact period aggregates and nonempty fund balance', () => { pm.expect(body.summary.opening).to.eql('100.0000'); pm.expect(body.summary.income).to.eql('999.0000'); pm.expect(body.summary.outflow).to.eql('2.0000'); pm.expect(body.summary.closing).to.eql('1097.0000'); pm.expect(body.fundBalances[0].balance).to.eql('777.0000'); });
pm.test('No search metadata when q is absent', () => pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('search'));
pm.collectionVariables.set('baselineSummary', JSON.stringify(body.summary)); pm.collectionVariables.set('baselineFunds', JSON.stringify(body.fundBalances));
pm.test('HTTP 200 from the actual-view local harness', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Explicit synthetic evidence boundary', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Fixture-Mode')).to.eql('actual-view-synthetic-session-no-db-auth'));
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('No search metadata and all period rows remain', () => { pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('search'); pm.expect(body.pagination.totalItems).to.eql(1000); });

pm.test('Period totals and current fund balances are independent of q', () => { pm.expect(body.summary).to.deep.eql(JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('baselineSummary'))); pm.expect(body.fundBalances).to.deep.eql(JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('baselineFunds'))); });
pm.test('HTTP 200 from the actual-view local harness', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Explicit synthetic evidence boundary', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Fixture-Mode')).to.eql('actual-view-synthetic-session-no-db-auth'));
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('No search metadata and all period rows remain', () => { pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('search'); pm.expect(body.pagination.totalItems).to.eql(1000); });

pm.test('Period totals and current fund balances are independent of q', () => { pm.expect(body.summary).to.deep.eql(JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('baselineSummary'))); pm.expect(body.fundBalances).to.deep.eql(JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('baselineFunds'))); });

item.name: Case-insensitive whole-period search finds a record beyond the first page
